## Why

No single source answers, at any point in a mission: what does it close, what does it do, where is it, and what should a handoff cite? Issue references are scattered across spec, plan and WP files; `purpose_tldr` sits in `meta.json` but is never surfaced at agent boundaries; WP status must be reduced from the event log each time. items.title: The Surprising Reasons China Is Skeptical of A.I. Safety Calls
items.summary: This article makes a good point. If you make the company itself have culpability for what it’s “rogue” agents do then you solve a lot of the problems. Tech executives might not care about humanity but they probably care about themselves. If the CEO of OpenAI is as legally responsible for what OpenAI’s software does in the same manner that Sam Bankman-Fried was responsible…I suspect many AI companies would not be so cavalier about letting their models do dangerous things.
